narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think the bracket five plus seven h becomes minus five plus seven h. The sign changes only the first term.
<bookmark mark='s1'/>The minus sign changes every term in the bracket.
<bookmark mark='s3'/>The bracket five plus seven h is twelve, and eight minus twelve is minus four.
<bookmark mark='s4'/>But eight h minus five plus seven h gives ten.
